standard-dialogue.npc: Hello, young [sir/lady/one]. Did you want to work on my farm?

steps.npc: I grow fruit here. Special fruit. It grows very fast, but it needs a lot of tending, otherwise it gets the blight and dies.
These days I'm getting old and slow. You can see all the dead plants from where I've tried to farm them.

options.text: I'd like to work on your farm.

options.condition: If any vyre in Darkmeyer mentioned the "Tithe Farm" when spoken to:

steps.npc: It is most of the time. Something very strange did happen recently though.
Well, you see... Two strange hooded figures recently visited the farm. They had an odd smell to them and kept their faces hidden.
They said they represented some client from the far east and that they wanted to inspect the farm. They had a good look around but seemed rather disappointed when they left.

steps.player: Oh... I'm sure it was nothing.

steps.npc: I'm a fruit farmer. But now I'm a bit too old for that. Maybe I should try writing books again, like I did when I was younger.

options.text: I'd like to work on your farm.

steps.player: I'd like to work on your farm.

steps.npc: Alright. Take a handful of seeds from the table, and head into the farm. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
Remember, you have to water the plants at each stage, otherwise they die of the blight. Fertiliser makes them grow faster... or die faster if you don't water them.
You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully.

steps.text: (Game opens the rewards interface for the Tithe Farm.)
steps.target: rewards interface for the Tithe Farm

wearing-vyre-noble-clothing.npc: What on earth are you wearing?

wearing-vyre-noble-clothing.player: I'm here to do some tithing. Blood tithing.

wearing-vyre-noble-clothing.npc: Well this is not that kind of farm! I only let normal people work here, so get lost!

using-items-on-him-farming-manual.text: You show the book to Farmer Gricoller.

using-items-on-him-farming-manual.npc: Oh, yes, I remember writing that a long time ago. I told the publisher it should be in the public domain, so that everyone could share the knowledge.
Of course, that was before I got so old and found I couldn't afford to hire workers for my farm. Oh well, I hope it helped someone. It wasn't much use to anyone around here.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Are you the 'Gric' this entry mentions?

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.text: You show him 'Lunch by the Lancalliums'.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.npc: Yes, I was friends with the last king, it was very sad when he died. The accusations aimed at poor little Rose were ridiculous.
It was all nonesense, the king died naturally! He was old, he'd been on the throne for at least 40 years.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Interesting, so he must have waited a while before having children?

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.npc: Indeed, he married late and his wife... Unfortunately didn't survive bringing Rose into this world.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Oh right, have you seen Rose recently?

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.npc: No... After the incident she was locked away. Most have forgotten about her now.

using-items-on-him-kharedst-s-memoirs-wi.player: Thanks for the information, Gric. Perhaps it'll all make sense once I've found the other pages.

using-items-on-him-sulphurous-fertiliser.npc: Ah, fertiliser. I use a lot of that, but I get mine from Hosidius. If you want to give yours to them, go to their storehouse near the bank.

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-strawhat.npc: I'll give you 60 of my reward points for that.

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-strawhat.text: Farmer's strawhat: Exchange the item for 60 reward points?

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-jacket.npc: I'll give you 120 of my reward points for that.

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-jacket.text: Farmer's jacket: Exchange the item for 120 reward points?

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-shirt.npc: I'll give you 120 of my reward points for that.

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-shirt.text: Farmer's shirt: Exchange the item for 120 reward points?

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-boro-trouser.npc: I'll give you 100 of my reward points for that.

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-boro-trouser.text: Farmer's boro trousers: Exchange the item for 100 reward points?

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-boots.npc: I'll give you 40 of my reward points for that.

using-items-on-him-farmer-s-boots.text: Farmer's boots: Exchange the item for 40 reward points?

when-entering-the-tithe-farm.text: If the player is not carrying Golovanova seeds, Bologano seeds, or Logavano seeds:

steps.npc: Take some seeds from the table, otherwise you can't do any farming in there!

when-entering-the-tithe-farm.npc: Hey, young [sir/lady/one], do you know what you're doing in there?

options.text: Tell me how to grow these crops.

steps.npc: Grow those seeds in the patches. When you've harvested some fruit, deposit it straight into the sacks.
Remember, you have to water the plants at each stage, otherwise they die of the blight. Fertiliser makes them grow faster... or die faster if you don't water them.
You'll gain a little extra experience if you grow enough of the fruit successfully. So, are you ready to start?

options.text: Yes, I know what I'm doing.

steps.player: Yes, I know what I'm doing.

steps.text: The player enters the Tithe Farm

options.text: I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.

steps.player: I'm an expert - don't ask me this again.

steps.npc: Alright, young [sir/lady/one], I won't. Talk to me if you ever want a reminder.

steps.text: The player enters the Tithe Farm

options.text: I don't want to do this anymore.
